story.text: 한강공원 잔디밭 위로 일요일 오후의 햇살이 나른하게 쏟아졌다. 돗자리 위에 널브러진 규현은 하늘을 향해 팔다리를 쭉 뻗었다.
story.reading: han-gang-gong-won jan-di-bat wi-ro il-yo-il o-hu-ui haet-sal-i na-reun-ha-ge sso-da-jyeot-da. dot-ja-ri wi-e neol-beu-reo-jin gyu-hyeon-eun ha-neul-eul hyang-hae pal-da-ri-reul jjuk ppeot-eot-da.
story.en: Sunday afternoon sunlight spilled lazily over the grass at Han River Park. Sprawled on the picnic mat, Kyuhyun stretched his arms and legs out toward the sky.

story.text: "주말엔 역시 이렇게 늘어지는 게 최고죠." 그가 눈을 지그시 감으며 만족스럽게 중얼거렸다.
story.reading: "ju-mal-en yeok-si i-reo-ke neul-eo-ji-neun ge choe-go-jyo." geu-ga nun-eul ji-geu-si gam-eu-myeo man-jok-seu-reop-ge jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da.
story.en: "On weekends, lying around like this really is the best." He murmured contentedly, eyes closed.

story.text: "저는 좀 쉬어야겠어요. 이번 주는 유난히 길었거든요." 나도 그 옆에 나란히 누워 눈을 감았다. 바람이 기분 좋게 뺨을 스쳤다.
story.reading: "jeo-neun jom swi-eo-ya-get-eo-yo. i-beon ju-neun yu-nan-hi gil-eot-geo-deun-yo." na-do geu yeop-e na-ran-hi nu-wo nun-eul gam-at-da. ba-ram-i gi-bun jo-ke ppyam-eul seu-chyeot-da.
story.en: "I really need to rest. This week felt especially long." I lay down beside him and closed my eyes too. The breeze felt pleasant against my cheek.

story.text: "근데 아가씨는 취미가 뭐예요?" 그가 고개만 살짝 돌려 물었다. "쉬는 날 뭐 하고 노나 궁금해서요."
story.reading: "geun-de a-ga-ssi-neun chwi-mi-ga mwo-ye-yo?" geu-ga go-gae-man sal-jjak dol-lyeo mul-eot-da. "swi-neun nal mwo ha-go no-na gung-geum-hae-seo-yo."
story.en: "So what's your hobby, miss?" He turned his head slightly to ask. "I'm curious what you do for fun on your days off."

story.text: 내가 되묻자 그는 잠깐 머뭇거리더니, 가방에서 조그만 수첩을 꺼내 보였다. "...그냥, 가끔 이런 데 끄적여요." 그러고는 헛기침을 하며 서둘러 수첩을 도로 집어넣었다.
story.reading: nae-ga doe-mut-ja geu-neun jam-kkan meo-mut-geo-ri-deo-ni, ga-bang-e-seo jo-geu-man su-cheob-eul kkeon-nae bo-yeot-da. "...geu-nyang, ga-kkeum i-reon de kkeu-jeog-yeo-yo." geu-reo-go-neun heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo seo-dul-leo su-cheob-eul do-ro jib-eo-neoh-eot-da.
story.en: When I asked him back, he hesitated for a moment, then pulled a small notebook from his bag. "...Just, sometimes I doodle in this." Then he cleared his throat and hurriedly tucked the notebook away again.

story.text: "그럼 우리 슬슬 강변이나 산책할까요?" 그가 어색함을 감추듯 벌떡 일어나 손을 내밀었다.
story.reading: "geu-reom u-ri seul-seul gang-byeon-i-na san-chaek-hal-kka-yo?" geu-ga eo-saek-ham-eul gam-chu-deut beol-tteok il-eo-na son-eul nae-mil-eot-da.
story.en: "Well then, shall we take a walk along the river?" He jumped up as if to hide his awkwardness, and held out his hand.

story.text: 강물을 따라 나란히 걷는 동안, 나는 문득 이런 여유로운 시간이 참 오랜만이라는 생각이 들었다. 규현도 같은 생각을 하는지, 말없이 미소를 짓고 있었다.
story.reading: gang-mul-eul tta-ra na-ran-hi geot-neun dong-an, na-neun mun-deuk i-reon yeo-yu-ro-un si-gan-i cham o-raen-man-i-ra-neun saeng-gag-i deul-eot-da. gyu-hyeon-do gat-eun saeng-gag-eul ha-neun-ji, mal-eob-si mi-so-reul jit-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: Walking side by side along the river, I suddenly realized how long it had been since I'd had such a relaxed stretch of time. Kyuhyun seemed to be thinking the same thing, smiling quietly without a word.

words.example_en: What do you do on weekends?
I'm going to rest at home today.
Want to take a walk together?
I like this kind of relaxed time.
